messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — we're planning the pricing page refresh next week. Main asks: final FAQ tweaks, new tier names (shortlist below), micro-calculator embed, and how we route webinar signups/inbound leads. Launch target: Thu 10am PT. Need owner for launch posts + benchmark narrative.
Jorge (Growth): +1. I can own the launch post and benchmark headline. Will need token cost numbers from Alex and screenshots from Sam.
Priya (Content): I can do FAQ copy and commit to a draft by Tue noon. Can we agree on tone: direct, cost-forward, with clear tradeoffs? Something like: "Predictable pricing for production inference".
Sam (Design): I'll drop updated hero and calculator UI by Wed EOD. Sharing a quick Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/pricing-refresh (work-in-progress)
Alex (Data): I ran the tier cost sims. Short summary in the doc: median per-1000-token cost estimates across models, and latency percentiles for each slab. Putting numbers in the shared sheet now. If you want the quick CSV: /drive/pricing-sims.csv
Casey (BizOps): For inbound routing — recommend: webinar signups -> marketing SDR queue; high monthly commit leads (>= $5k m) -> sales-assist via webhook. We need gtm@ to confirm thresholds.
Maya (PM): @Jorge please draft the benchmark narrative focusing on latency/cost tradeoffs vs. public endpoints. Keep it 3 bullets + 1 CTA to webinar. @Priya match the FAQ to those bullets.
Jorge (Growth): Will do. Quick question: what variant names are we testing? My shortlist: "Starter, Scale, Enterprise" feels generic. Thoughts?
Priya (Content): I pushed an alternate set in the doc: "Hatch, Momentum, Anchor" — more product-y but might confuse non-technical buyers.
Sam (Design): Preference for short single-word names. Also suggest we add microcopy under each tier: "best for X" lines.
Alex (Data): A/B note — we can test tier-name clarity on the pricing CTA click-through. Can add an experiment tag in Analytics.
Maya (PM): OK let's A/B test names: A = conventional (Starter/Scale/Enterprise), B = evocative (Hatch/Momentum/Anchor). Target: 20% traffic to variant B for 2 weeks.
Priya (Content): Drafting FAQ items now. Key new Qs: "How do you measure per-token billing?", "When should I pick Dedicated vs Hosted?", "How does caching affect cost?" — proposing short answers and a link to docs.
Jorge (Growth): Webinar plan: 30-min tech talk + 15-min product Q&A. Landing page -> calc -> whitelist signup. Need a short speaker line for the event page.
Maya (PM): Speakers: me (prod), Alex (benchmarks), Sam (UX). @calendar-bot please create draft event for Thu 10am PT and invite presenters.
calendar-bot: Event created "Pricing refresh — benchmark webinar" Thu 10:00 PT — presenters invited.
Casey (BizOps): Routing details for follow-ups: put webinar registrants in HubSpot list "pricing-webinar-registrants"; map form field "expected_monthly_usage" to lead score. I'll share the Zapier webhook snippet.
Priya (Content): Also adding a tiny micro-calculator copy prompt: "Enter avg prompt tokens / month" -> shows estimated monthly spend and recommended tier.
Sam (Design): Quick embed snippet for the calculator (dev):
```
<!-- pricing micro-calculator embed -->
<iframe src="https://redwood.example/embed/pricing-calc?variant=b" width="480" height="320"></iframe>
```
Jorge (Growth): Dev note — we need an AMP-friendly iframe or progressive fallback. @engineering-frontend FYI.
Maya (PM): Action owners: Jorge = launch post & webinar narrative; Priya = FAQ + webinar copy; Sam = visuals + embed; Alex = benchmark numbers + analytics tag; Casey = inbound routing + hubspot mapping. Can everyone confirm?
Alex (Data): Confirm. I'll also supply margin assumptions and a CSV for the publishable chart.
Casey (BizOps): Confirm. I'll set up the webhook and the hubspot list tonight.
Priya (Content): Confirmed. Will post FAQ draft in doc by Tue noon and link it here.
Sam (Design): Confirmed. I'll attach final Figma frames and export assets Wed.
Jorge (Growth): Confirmed. Posting launch draft by Wed morning for review.
Maya (PM): Great — one more: can we include a one-paragraph benchmark blurb for the homepage hero? Short: "Redwood inference: predictable inference costs at production scale — low-latency, optimized routes, and billing transparency." I'll draft but welcome edits.
Jorge (Growth): I'll tighten that into something snappier for social and the blog.
Maya (PM): Thanks team. Closing checklist: docs link, embed snippet, webinar event, hubspot mapping, A/B run config. Ping me if blocked.
Priya (Content): Pinged with doc: https://docs.google.com/pricing-faq-draft — comments welcome :mag:
Maya (PM): Closing — moving this to the launch channel after drafts. :rocket:
